scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm run env:init
scripts.env:init: [ -f backend/.env ] || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env; [ -f frontend/.env.local ] || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
